user.title: Set up Vattenfall InCharge
user.description: Create a local Vattenfall InCharge session for public charging stations and optional MyCharge account data.

add_first_station.title: Add first charging station
add_first_station.description: Add charging point by name, for example VA5672 or QW7214. You can find the charging point name in the Vattenfall InCharge app. Vattenfall InCharge stations are fully supported. Other networks are partially supported.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Vattenfall InCharge

abort.already_configured: This Vattenfall InCharge device is already configured

add_charging_point.title: Add charging point
add_charging_point.description: Add charging point by name, for example VA5672 or QW7214. You can find the charging point name in the Vattenfall InCharge app. Vattenfall InCharge stations are fully supported. Other networks are partially supported.

remove_charging_points.title: Remove charging point
remove_charging_points.description: Select one or more configured stations to remove.

mycharge_account.title: Add MyCharge account
mycharge_account.description:
Open the MyCharge login URL below in your browser, complete the login and OTP flow, then paste the full final callback URL here. If your browser shows an error after login, copy the URL from the address bar or browser error message.

{auth_url}

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Update settings that apply to the whole integration.
